episode_title: Transforming Your Darkest Moments into Healing with Heather LaFond

real_qa.q: How does Heather LaFond approach healing through multiple bodies beyond physical fitness?
real_qa.r: Heather explains that her approach looks at the physical side like traditional personal training, but also integrates mindset work and emotions stored in the body through somatic and energy healing. She addresses the spiritual body, stating we have several bodies to heal on multiple levels to really move past negative experiences and trauma, rather than just focusing on appearance.
real_qa.requete: Heather LaFond healing multiple bodies approach

real_qa.q: What are the four clairs that Heather LaFond uses as a psychic medium and which is her strongest?
real_qa.r: Heather has clairsentience (feeling), clairaudience (hearing), clairvoyance (seeing), and claircognizance (knowing). Her strongest clair is clairsentience, where she feels energy through goosebumps or sensations in her body that help her understand individuals and identify which side (right for masculine, left for feminine) spirit is approaching from.

real_qa.q: What happened during Heather LaFond's Reiki healing in Arizona that removed a black bruise under the ribs?
real_qa.r: During a Reiki session at an Airbnb in Arizona, Heather entered a trance state and sensed heavy energy in her friend's body, tuning into past life situations where the friend had lost her life. She guided the friend through releasing that energy, and a dark black bruise the size of a quarter under one rib that normally takes weeks to heal completely disappeared within two days without the friend initially telling her about the bruise.
real_qa.requete: Heather LaFond Arizona Reiki healing bruise disappeared

real_qa.q: How long has Heather LaFond been running a business and how has it evolved?
real_qa.r: Heather has had a business in some shape or form for the past 13 years, starting as personal training and group fitness focused before evolving as she evolved. She recognized clients needed more than workouts, so she added nutrition coaching, then mindset work through hypnotherapy to address self-sabotage, creating a business that shifts with what clients need and what she herself needs.
real_qa.requete: Heather LaFond 13 years business evolution personal training spiritual

real_qa.q: What does Heather LaFond say is the biggest gap for awakened clients trying to heal root problems?
real_qa.r: Heather states that clients get stuck trying to make logical sense of their issues and consciously remember their cause, but the subconscious mind shoves things down to protect us, so conscious thinking won't reveal that information. Over 13 years, she evolved her business from fitness-focused services to spiritual healing work, adding hypnotherapy, neuro-linguistic programming, and shamanic practices as she recognized clients needed deeper, root-level healing beyond physical training. She now operates as a soul rebirth doula guiding highly sensitive people through spiritual awakening, hosting retreats at sacred sites, and running a soul activation program.
